latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.4.0

- Added four example/template files: sample-full-process-weekly, sample-san-di-weekly, sample-shoujian-songjian-weekly, and template-choices-zh.
- Introduced multi-variant weekly/monthly report templates: Simple, Complete process, Multi-site summary, and First-inspection/submission/process (首检送检制程).
- Added workflow requiring explicit template selection for weekly/monthly reports, with a template menu for users to choose from before proceeding.
- Expanded trigger phrases to support new report types and variants (e.g. 简单周报, 复杂月报, simple weekly report).
- Updated workflow and instructions for chart/chart-data output, especially for 首检送检制程, requiring visual elements (Mermaid/chart spec) in reports.
- Refined mapping from user input to template structure, integrating new example/template files for advanced reports.
